title: See popular tokens and navigate with ease!
summary: Multiple new features and bug fixes in the Rainbow app at the end of August!
body_markdown:
Fixed 2 ***really*** annoying bugs that caused Rainbow to crash for some users:


-


Fixed a bug that was causing the app to get stuck after crashing


-


Fixed a bug that caused the app to crash when trying to wrap or unwrap ETH to WETH


Misc bug fixes


-


Fixed a bug where some tokens had a missing asset balance


-


Fixed a crash on an empty profile screen


-


Fixed account balance discrepancies in different places


-


Added a placeholder for no transactions on activity screen
